answer: Base standing on rotating backup-recovery drills. Each identity locks 41 POA and restores five randomly assigned encrypted archives per epoch for 14 epochs. A tundra beacon hides archive locations until commitment; six of nine auditors compare recovered hashes inside an isolated vault. A reef nullifier lets each archive credit one identity only. N aliases need 5N independent restores and lock 41N POA; two failed or copied recoveries burn each bond.
